reviews.title: Add a public review section as identity testing ground
reviews.notes: Public stand-in. The section root is the list, never a blank landing. Verdict, confidence, and run status stay readable next to notes, links, and required actions. Share the preview look from the Appearance panel; token drafts stay on the advanced editor.

actions.title: Keep the empty state useful
actions.detail: When there are no reviews yet, say what will appear and that the page is still the list.

actions.title: Lead with the verdict
actions.detail: Actions and notes come next. Agent detail stays behind a disclosure.

findings.summary: The section root must be the list, never a blank landing.

reviews.title: Presentation blockers (pick a look, one promise, stability)
reviews.notes: Public stand-in. The home must pick a look before the kit pitch, keep one promise in the lead, and hold first-load stability. Caption contrast on dense notes still needs a follow-up.

actions.title: Pick a look before the pitch
actions.detail: The identity chooser has to come before the kit promise so a visitor can judge the page in a real look.

findings.summary: The home must pick a look before the kit pitch.

reviews.title: Lead component pages with usage before install
reviews.notes: Public stand-in. First pass asked to keep maturity in the catalog badge. Reconciliation kept the usage-before-install order and dismissed the badge move. The reconciled decision is Approve.

actions.title: Show usage before install
actions.detail: A component page leads with how to use the brick, then how to install it.

findings.summary: Install sat above usage on the component page.
Stable maturity belonged in the catalog badge, not the page header.
